notes.title: Update on November 11, 2020
notes.notes:
Update on November 11, 2020:
1. Fix the texture bug of Angel Garden
2. Fixed a bug where players could pass through walls in some places in the palace church
3. Fixed a bug that caused strange noises in some places in Julia's House
4. Fixed the bug that Lan Yanyi and Ye Xiaoxue in the bonus room could not complete the achievement
5. Fixed the bug that the deformed water can be used after the puzzle is solved

In addition, we are here to give you some Lydia QQ emoticons, I hope you will like them!

notes.title: Update on November 7, 2020
notes.notes:
Update on November 7, 2020:
1. Fixed some text errors.
2. Optimized the stickers for female customers in the living room.
3. Fixed some map bugs in the underground city.
4. Optimized the interval between T-Card cards.

Game guide has now been uploaded to the guide.
Chinese：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2279581545
English ：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2279609491

Author's words: Thank you for your support to our game! If you find any bugs in the game, please let us know in time! thank you all!
The main story of this game has been released to the public, and the production team is currently working on the follow-up DLC story. The DLC story will be updated for free next year! You can play without spending any more money!

The new plot will have a better plot and better gameplay~

PS: The Aegean school in the game, a few apartments, and the mysterious well on the sea, etc., are actually the content of the subsequent update plot, and the fox can reveal a few information in advance: Aegean school It will be very beautiful, there is a new world under that well, and a certain protagonist of Princess Lili will appear again in the DLC plot!

Stay tuned!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38841054/e8da1ab522ec6f69c3c0b50db71084b32bc48cfb.png
【Release Preview】
Hello everyone, I am 游学者狐狸.

The Chinese and English versions of our new game "WhiteLily 2: Waking up Girl" will be officially released on Steam on November 6, 2020 (around 18:00 Beijing time / around 6:00 Washington time). And unlock the purchase. Welcome everyone to play our game!

At the same time, we will hold a lottery on the Steam Community Announcement, Bilibili (游学者狐狸), and Sina Weibo (游学者狐狸) on November 6.

This time, we have prepared some mysterious gifts (Princess Lili’s physical prizes!) as prizes. Welcome everyone to participate!
